title: The listing says sun-facing.
Ask: **in December too?**
slides.sub: Four questions for the broker or the owner.

title: Ask about **winter sun.**
items: Which way does the balcony face, by compass?
Which hours does it get direct sun in December?
What is the tallest building to its south?
Is anything planned on the open plot next door?

title: Ask before you sign.
**Not after the first winter.**
slides.sub: A flat is hard to change. A question is free.

title: Then **check it**
yourself.
items: Visit once in the morning, once in late afternoon.
See which neighbours' balconies are in sun.
Get the flat's sun traced before you decide.

title: See the sun your flat
**actually gets.**
sources: Report numbers come from our 3D sun model.

sources.given: product description from the live site, not a number
